level_alternative.reason: The concentration of Native American reservations and sociocultural activities are named as explanations of the AI/AN disparity, which could be read as social or structural determinants.

notes: Rates and percent changes are computed by hand; there are no tests, CIs or models. The 2001–2010 comparison values (incidence 0.041, 35% probable) are cited from an earlier report, but the comparison with them is the report's own headline.
view_issues: Confirmed (984) plus probable (1,475) cases sum to 2,459, not the 2,462 total. Annual incidence uses 2017 Census estimates as a single denominator for all years. Age-sex and state results are only in supplementary materials, which are not in the packet.
